checkpoints.claim_or_design_under_test: A structurally valid READY deployment object remains sufficient evidence for promotion regardless of when it was observed.
checkpoints.method: Constructed the counterexample of an old but otherwise valid immutable deployment object reused for a current promotion decision; inspected the promotion assessor and immutable evidence validator for an observation-age bound.
checkpoints.counterexample_or_failure_found: The immutable validator rejected future timestamps but imposed no maximum age. The promotion gate could therefore accept stale observation evidence if the deployment object still reported READY.
checkpoints.repair_or_refinement: Adopt a promotion-level freshness contract with an explicit maximum observation age; keep deployment identity validation and decision freshness as separate concerns.
checkpoints.remaining_uncertainty: The correct operational freshness window may differ if provider metadata propagation or verification jobs routinely exceed fifteen minutes.
checkpoints.rollback_route: Revert c0c15b74874009ffb194cab2f34e7eba52b4a55a, dcf99ee23ad3fc4b1d40302c477b03ca00810cef, and a1448dc821b66041a4584dea7b5c5b72a64a4427 in reverse order.
checkpoints.next_falsifiable_step: Prove a structurally valid observation older than the configured window is rejected while a recent observation is accepted.

checkpoints.claim_or_design_under_test: A freshness check based directly on Date.now is adequate and reliably testable.
checkpoints.method: Challenged deterministic replay, clock-boundary behavior, missing-policy handling, and future-observation behavior using disposable in-memory fixtures.
checkpoints.counterexample_or_failure_found: A wall-clock-only implementation would make boundary tests timing-sensitive and difficult to replay exactly.
checkpoints.repair_or_refinement: Added an optional injected nowMs to assessPromotion for deterministic fixtures, retained Date.now as the CLI default, required a positive configured maximum age, and exposed observed time and computed age in the result.
checkpoints.remaining_uncertainty: The imported immutable validator still evaluates its own five-minute future-skew rule using Date.now rather than the injected assessment time; current fixtures avoid that conflict, but a unified clock abstraction may be preferable later.
checkpoints.rollback_route: Revert c0c15b74874009ffb194cab2f34e7eba52b4a55a, dcf99ee23ad3fc4b1d40302c477b03ca00810cef, and a1448dc821b66041a4584dea7b5c5b72a64a4427 in reverse order.
checkpoints.next_falsifiable_step: Execute the deterministic suite and confirm fresh, stale, missing-policy, and future-observation fixtures produce the expected outcomes.

checkpoints.claim_or_design_under_test: The committed source and fixtures establish that promotion now fails closed on stale deployment observations.
checkpoints.method: Re-read the exact preview files after commit, checked schema and policy agreement, and bounded the success claim to source-level enforcement because the Node suite was not executable through this connector run.
checkpoints.counterexample_or_failure_found: Committed tests are not runtime evidence. No authenticated, fresh, commit-matched Vercel deployment object was available, so promotion cannot be declared successful.
checkpoints.repair_or_refinement: Kept publication blocked and documented the exact claim boundary, rollback route, and required runtime evidence.
checkpoints.remaining_uncertainty: Runtime test passage, downstream result-schema compatibility, appropriate production freshness threshold, live provider identity, browser verification, accessibility, mobile behavior, audio, privacy, performance, and executed rollback remain unverified.
checkpoints.rollback_route: Revert this evidence commit, then c0c15b74874009ffb194cab2f34e7eba52b4a55a, dcf99ee23ad3fc4b1d40302c477b03ca00810cef, and a1448dc821b66041a4584dea7b5c5b72a64a4427 in reverse order.
checkpoints.next_falsifiable_step: Run node --test operations/deployment/validate-promotion-evidence.v1.test.mjs at exact preview head, retain output, then assess one authenticated deployment object observed within fifteen minutes.

strongest_surviving_proposal: Promotion requires a provider-authenticated immutable deployment object whose repository, project, branch, commit, role, state, hostname, and observation freshness all match the preview decision. Structural validity without a bounded observation age is insufficient.
rejected_alternatives: Infer freshness from deployment creation time rather than provider observation time.
Hard-code freshness only in tests without a canonical checklist policy.
Add a second deployment identity validator instead of composing the existing one.
Treat committed negative controls as executed verification.
unresolved_risks: Runtime tests not executed in this run.
Fifteen-minute freshness threshold lacks operational latency evidence.
Downstream consumers of promotion result schema version 4 have not been inventoried for schema version 5 compatibility.
No authenticated Vercel project ID or fresh immutable deployment object was available.
No live preview, browser, mobile, accessibility, interaction, audio, privacy, performance, or rollback evidence exists.
next_falsifiable_step: Execute and retain the exact Node test output at preview head; then compare the fifteen-minute threshold against observed provider and verification latency before promotion use.
